claims.text: Push changes to Lynx
claims.note: The toolbar button is CASE_SENSITIVE.PUSH_CHANGES "Push Changes" and the dialog footer is STRINGS.PUSH_N_CHANGES_TO_LYNX "Push {{num}} changes to Lynx".

claims.text: Review, deselect, send and verify.
claims.note: Review is the dialog table, deselect is the per-row checkbox, send is the footer button, and verify is the automatic read-back comparison in the push service.

claims.text: Review every pending adjustment, drop the ones you do not want, and send the rest to the controller.
claims.note: The pending list is every enabled station whose % Adj. differs from what Lynx holds (sa-dashboard.component.ts:659-662). Rows can be unticked, and only the ticked rows are sent. The pending list also contains stations already pushed today, which arrive unticked (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.ts:23-24). "The controller" is read as Lynx Central Control: the push writes each station's percent adjust to Lynx (lynx-cloud.service.ts:80-95). Reaching the field also needs the push-then-synchronise step that 373-1135 rev 02 §Push Changes Dialog Box, p.10 requires, as recorded by feature 5 in docs/claims/operational-contract.md (OC-3, OC-4). That step is feature 5's operational-contract wording, not a fault in this sentence.

claims.text: Toolbar › Push Changes
claims.note: The Push Changes button is the first control in the toolbar's right-hand group (#sa-tb-right).

claims.text: Lynx must be reachable.
claims.note: Retyped from prerequisite to behaviour. The source settles it without 373-1135: every write goes through the Lynx Cloud or Lynx Drive service (lynx-proxy.service.ts:148-150), and when Lynx stops answering the product says so in its own copy, SPATIAL_ADJUST.CONNECTION_LOST_MSG "Connection to Lynx lost. Unable to retrieve or update Percent Adjust values. Please ensure Lynx is online and try again." This is the IntelliDash-to-Lynx connection, not a Lynx-side setting.

claims.text: If the connection is lost an amber banner appears above the toolbar and percent adjust values cannot be read or written.
claims.note: Retyped from prerequisite to behaviour. The banner is .sa-top-banner, drawn before the toolbar in spatial-adjust-main.component.html, with background #f59e0b (amber). It is raised when the 30-second heartbeat ping fails (sa-dashboard.component.ts:827-841) and cleared when a ping succeeds. Its text is SPATIAL_ADJUST.CONNECTION_LOST_MSG, which says Percent Adjust values can be neither retrieved nor updated.

claims.text: Stations already pushed today are listed separately and arrive unselected, so you do not adjust the same head twice.
claims.note: Retyped from prerequisite to behaviour. Stations whose last push falls on the current course-local day go into a separate Pushed Today list and are unticked on load. The dialog's own banner, SPECIAL_MSG.PUSH_STATION_CHANGES, gives the same reason: "to prevent double adjustments".

claims.text: Check the pending count
claims.note: The pending count is carried in the button label itself, CASE_SENSITIVE.PUSH_N_CHANGES "Push {{ num }} Changes".

claims.text: The button reads the number of stations with an unpushed edit.
claims.note: The number in the label is the count of pending stations that have not been pushed today (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:153-160). It differs from "stations with an unpushed edit" in two ways. A station is pending whenever its % Adj. differs from what Lynx holds, and % Adj. starts as the suggestion when the user has not edited it (sa-dashboard.component.ts:597-598), so unedited suggestions are counted too. A station already pushed today that has a pending change is left out of the count, and when every pending station has been pushed today the label drops the number and reads "Push Changes".
claims.correction: The button counts the stations whose % Adj. differs from what Lynx holds, whether you edited it or left the suggestion, leaving out any already pushed today. Why: pending means "differs from Lynx", suggestions included, and the label counts only stations not yet pushed today (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:153-160).

claims.text: Beside it the green counter shows how many have already gone out today.
claims.note: The counter sits immediately after the Push Changes button, on a green tint (background #42CE111A, border #18AD0733). Its number comes from the API, which counts stations whose LastPushUtc falls inside the course-local day. Every station that was sent is stamped, including any that later fail to verify (sa-push-changes.service.ts:174-175), so the counter counts attempts, not confirmed changes.

claims.text: If Push Changes is greyed out there is nothing queued.
claims.note: The button is disabled when the pending list is empty, and also while a push is running (isProcessingUpdates). Stations already pushed today keep it enabled if they still have a pending change, even though the label then shows no number.

claims.text: Six changes pending, six already pushed today.
claims.note: Figure caption. The toolbar shows both numbers: the pending count in the button label and the pushed-today count in the green counter.

claims.text: Review the two lists
claims.note: The two lists are CASE_SENSITIVE.N_AVAIL_TO_PUSH "{{num}} Available to Push" and CASE_SENSITIVE.N_PUSHED_TODAY "{{num}} Pushed Today".

claims.text: The dialog puts the current value on the left and the change on the right.
claims.note: Column headers STRINGS.CURRENT "Current" and STRINGS.CHANGES "Changes". The left cell shows currentAdjAmtPercent, the value read from Lynx (sa-dashboard.component.ts:594), and the right cell shows the proposed value.

claims.text: Available to Push comes first, with everything ticked; Pushed Today follows, unticked.
claims.note: Available to Push is drawn first. Its rows start ticked because a pending station defaults to submitChange true (sa-push-changes-station.model.ts:16). Pushed Today follows and its rows are unticked on load (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.ts:24). The Pushed Today header is drawn only when that list is not empty (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.html:103).

claims.text: Tick a pushed station only if you genuinely mean to adjust it a second time today.
claims.note: Advice that matches the dialog's own banner, SPECIAL_MSG.PUSH_STATION_CHANGES "To adjust one again, simply select it." One case the advice does not cover: a station whose push failed is also stamped as pushed today (sa-push-changes.service.ts:174-175), so it reappears in this list too, and ticking it is a retry, not a second adjustment. push-failures/4/2 is marked Wrong for the same reason.

claims.text: Push dialog.
claims.note: Figure caption. The dialog header is CASE_SENSITIVE.PUSH_CHANGES, title-cased, which reads "Push Changes".

claims.text: Current on the left, the proposed change on the right.
claims.note: Figure caption. Same evidence as push-to-lynx/2/2.

claims.text: Look for threshold adjustments
claims.note: Threshold adjustments are flagged per station in the toolbar (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:433-460) and summarised in the dialog banner.

claims.text: If a minimum threshold is set, a pink banner counts the stations it altered and each affected row shows the original percentage and the value that will actually be sent.
claims.note: The banner is drawn when at least one station is affected. Its text is #D93193 on a #D931931A tint (pink), and it reads SPATIAL_ADJUST.N_STATIONS_ADJUSTED_BY_MIN_THRESHOLD "{{num}} stations will be adjusted according to the minimum threshold rules." or, for one station, SPATIAL_ADJUST.ONE_STATION_ADJUSTED_BY_MIN_THRESHOLD. The count includes rows in both lists, including Pushed Today rows that are not ticked (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.ts:28). Each affected row keeps the original percentage and adds an arrow with "Adjusted to N%". That prefix is a hard-coded English literal in the template, so it is not translated.

claims.text: Review Threshold opens Settings on the threshold tab if the numbers look wrong.
claims.note: The link is SPATIAL_ADJUST.REVIEW_THRESHOLD "Review Threshold", shown upper-case. Clicking it closes the push dialog without sending anything and opens Settings on the Minimum Threshold tab.

claims.text: Two stations were adjusted by the minimum threshold before sending.
claims.note: Figure caption. The substitution happens at send time: the threshold value replaces the proposed value for every ticked row that carries an override (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.ts:74-79).

claims.text: Untick anything you are not sure about
claims.note: Every row in both lists has its own checkbox.

claims.text: The footer button counts only the ticked rows.
claims.note: The footer label takes its number from changesToSubmit, which is rebuilt from the ticked rows on every checkbox change.

claims.text: Unticking is not the same as reverting — the station keeps its edited value in the table and will be offered again next time.
claims.note: The dialog works on a deep copy of the pending list (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.ts:20), and unticking only removes a row from the list to send. Nothing is written back to the station. The station stays pending because its % Adj. still differs from what Lynx holds (sa-dashboard.component.ts:659-662), and an edited value is stored server-side (SpatialAdjustService.cs:1019-1038). One limit: the stored edit is cleared when a new scan arrives (SpatialAdjustService.cs:3052-3058), after which the station is offered with the new suggestion instead.

claims.text: The footer button always names the number of changes that will be sent.
claims.note: Figure caption. STRINGS.PUSH_N_CHANGES_TO_LYNX "Push {{num}} changes to Lynx", with num set to the number of ticked rows.

claims.text: Send and watch the progress
claims.note: Sending opens the "Pushing Changes To Lynx" progress dialog with a progress bar and a status line.

claims.text: Spatial Adjust first re-reads the current adjustments from Lynx for comparison, then writes station by station, then verifies.
claims.note: Still contradicted on production, and no transform touches it. The push handler starts the write loop directly (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:269). The first progress event is the writing step at 0% (sa-push-changes.service.ts:136-141), and every station is written before anything is read. The read from Lynx is issued only in the write loop's completion handler (:162-170), and the comparison runs when that read-back arrives (:56-81). The order is write, read back, compare, retry, the same error transform 12 fixed in verify-results (docs/text-corrections.md section 6). The wording probably comes from the product's own status line, SPATIAL_ADJUST.LYNX_PUSH_RETRIEVING "Retrieving latest Percent Adjustments from Lynx for comparison", which is shown after the writes.
claims.correction: Spatial Adjust writes station by station first, then reads the adjustments back from Lynx and checks each one against what it sent. Why: the write loop runs before any read (sa-push-changes.service.ts:126-161), and the read-back is issued only once every station has been written (:162-170). See docs/text-corrections.md section 6 and transform 12.

claims.text: Failed stations are retried automatically before the run is declared finished.
claims.note: Stations whose read-back value does not match are re-sent, up to MAX_RETRY_COUNT (2) further passes, before the run ends as Complete or Errors.

claims.text: Push in progress, station four of six.
claims.note: Figure caption. SPATIAL_ADJUST.LYNX_PUSH_PUSHING "Pushing Percent Adjustments to Lynx ({{index}} of {{count}})".

claims.text: Confirm the result
claims.note: When processing completes, the dialog swaps the progress bar for a result line and a Close button.

claims.text: A successful run confirms every selected change reached Lynx.
claims.note: Success is reported only when the read-back shows no mismatched station. It reads SPATIAL_ADJUST.LYNX_PUSH_SUCCESS "All selected changes successfully pushed to Lynx." One gap: a station that Lynx leaves out of its read-back entirely is counted as matched (sa-push-changes.service.ts:78), not as failed. The check covers Lynx, not the course. Whether a change made outside the push window still reaches the course is open as Q3 in docs/claims/operational-contract.md, and the dialog would report success either way.

claims.text: A failure names the number of stations that could not be updated — check the Lynx connection and push those again rather than the whole set.
claims.note: The first half is right. The error line is SPATIAL_ADJUST.LYNX_PUSH_ERROR "Unable to Push Changes for {{num}} Station(s). Check the connection to Lynx and try again." The second half describes a choice the dialog does not offer. Every station that was sent, failures included, is stamped as pushed today before the comparison (sa-push-changes.service.ts:174-175, sa-dashboard.component.ts:214-231). Stations that verified are no longer pending, so they cannot be offered again. The failed stations come back under Pushed Today, unticked (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.ts:23-24), Available to Push shows 0, and the toolbar button drops its count. A reader following the guide finds nothing ticked, and push-to-lynx/2/4 has just told them not to tick Pushed Today rows.
claims.correction: A failure names the number of stations that could not be updated. Check the Lynx connection, then reopen Push Changes: the failed stations are listed under Pushed Today, unticked, so tick them to send them again. Why: every station that was sent is stamped as pushed today before it is verified (sa-push-changes.service.ts:174-175), so the failures return unticked and the successful ones are not offered at all.

claims.text: All selected changes pushed successfully.
claims.note: Figure caption. SPATIAL_ADJUST.LYNX_PUSH_SUCCESS "All selected changes successfully pushed to Lynx."

claims.text: The Push Changes button is disabled and the pending count is zero.
claims.note: No "zero" is ever shown. When no pending station is left outside Pushed Today, the label drops the number and reads "Push Changes" (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:40). The button is disabled only when nothing at all is pending (:34). Several things keep it enabled after a good push: rows you unticked in step 4, Pushed Today rows you left unticked, and any station the minimum threshold rewrote. The threshold value is substituted on the dialog's copy only (sa-confirm-push-dlg.component.ts:20, :74-79), so after the push the table still holds the original % Adj. while Lynx holds the threshold value, and the station stays pending (sa-dashboard.component.ts:659-662).
claims.correction: Push Changes no longer counts the stations you sent. It is greyed out only if nothing else is waiting. Why: the label drops its number rather than showing zero, and unticked rows, Pushed Today rows and threshold-rewritten stations all stay pending (sa-dashboard.component.ts:659-662).

claims.text: The green pushed-today counter increased by the number you sent.
claims.note: After the push stamps the sent stations (sa-push-changes.service.ts:174-179), the pending list is rebuilt and the counter is re-fetched (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:163). The counter counts each station once per course-local day, so it grows by the number sent unless some of them were already in Pushed Today. A re-push of those adds nothing. Stations that failed are counted as well.

claims.text: Pushed rows in the table now show the pushed icon rather than the pending one.
claims.note: A row carries a push icon only while its station is pending. A station that is no longer pending has its icon cleared (sa-table-card.component.ts:262-268), so a row that pushed and verified shows no icon at all, not the pushed icon. The pushed-today icon (pushed_ico.png) appears only on a station that was pushed today and still differs from Lynx (:545-556): a failed station, or one the minimum threshold rewrote. The guide teaches the reader to read the pushed icon as success, which is the opposite of what it means.
claims.correction: Rows you pushed successfully no longer show a push icon at all. A row that still shows the pushed-today icon was sent but Lynx does not hold the value in the table. Why: the icon is drawn only for pending stations (sa-table-card.component.ts:262-268), and the pushed variant marks a pending station that was already pushed today (:545-556).
